title: wmem: Return newly created frame in wmem_list_(insert|append)_sorted
description:
When calling wmem_list_(insert|append)_sorted, it is sometimes useful
to get the frame where the list was just inserted. Since the position
is unknown (unlike with appending or prepending), this can take another
linear search. Return the newly created frame to prevent the extra call.

Use it in the TCPCL dissector, where this pattern occurs.
This also should make Coverity happier about CID 1620437.
(wmem_list_find_custom might return NULL and should be checked.)

AI-Assisted: no

changes_data.diff:
@@ -244,9 +244,10 @@ wmem_list_append(wmem_list_t *list, void *data);
  * @param func Comparison function of type `GCompareFunc` used to maintain sort order.
  *             Should return a negative value if the first argument is less than the second,
  *             zero if equal, and positive if greater.
+ * @return Pointer to the newly created frame containing the data pointer.
  */
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC
-void
+wmem_list_frame_t*
 wmem_list_insert_sorted(wmem_list_t *list, void* data, GCompareFunc func);
